A fix for devices that missed changes made elsewhere: a computer or phone that was away while many files changed on another device now picks them all up when it comes back.

More about it, and step-by-step install guides, at https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/

## Which file to download

- **Mac:** `telegrive-1.2.1-macos.dmg`, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 12 or newer. See [Opening it on a Mac](#opening-it-on-a-mac) below.
- **Android, most phones:** `telegrive-1.2.1-arm64-v8a.apk`
- **Android, older phones:** `telegrive-1.2.1-armeabi-v7a.apk`
- **Chromebooks and emulators:** `telegrive-1.2.1-x86_64.apk`
- **iPhone:** `telegrive-1.2.1.ipa`, installed with Sideloadly, SideStore or AltStore and your own Apple Account. Follow the [iPhone guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/iphone.html); it shows every step.

Each installs over 1.2.0 and keeps your drive and settings. `telegrive-1.2.1.aab` is the same Android app as a bundle for app stores; you don't need it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.

## Opening it on a Mac

Open the disk image and drag Telegrive onto Applications. Apple hasn't checked the app, so your Mac won't open it straight away the first time. The quickest way through is to paste this into Terminal and press Return:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Telegrive.app
```

Then open Telegrive from Applications. Without Terminal, open it once, click Done, and click Open Anyway in System Settings › Privacy & Security; the [Mac guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/mac.html) shows each step.

## Fixes

- **Changes made on another device always arrive.** Telegram replays what a device missed while it was closed, asleep or offline only up to about a hundred changes. Past that, a batch made elsewhere, like many files moved to Private, could stay out of sight until the next day. Now a device that comes back after more than half an hour away, or six hours on mobile data, reads your drive again in full. It takes seconds.
- **Every device reads the drive again once** after updating, so files made private or hidden from Photos on another device show where they belong straight away.
- Settings › Private says it holds files as well as folders.

## Support

Telegrive is free, with no ads. If it's useful to you, you can [send a tip on Jami](https://jami.bio/daveragoose). If something doesn't work, [report a problem](https://github.com/daveragos/telegrive/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
